text_block_list.text:
And that concludes our first lesson of
the new
year. I look forward to spending
a productive
year with everyone.
text_block_list.name: Teacher

text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Hayahideee! Let's
make it a
great one!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Happy New Year, Ticket. How
many times
do you plan to say that,
though? This is already
your third time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Really? Are you sure?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Well, that's okay! Hey, which crown are
you
gunning for this year?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown? The Triple
Tiara? I
chose—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Let me guess. You chose the Classic
Triple Crown
tour because it has the
Japanese Derby, right?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: No way! How'd you know?! That's exactly right! Running in the Derby's my dream!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is SO awesome! I
remember
how wild the crowd went
when I watched it with
my mom as a kid!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Spectator

text_block_list.text: What's wrong? Does your tummy hurt?!
text_block_list.name: Young Ticket

text_block_list.text: Sniff. It's not that. I'm just—hic!—so happy she won!
text_block_list.name: Spectator

text_block_list.text:
My dream has always been to see her
win the
Derby!
text_block_list.name: Spectator

text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Sob... The Derby is filled with so many dreams...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I swear, she must've told that story a
million times
already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, that's how important it is to
her.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I swear—one day, I'll be the Derby
Champiooon!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You should wipe your nose,
Ticket. Do you
have any tissues on you?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, what tour did you choose,
Hayahide?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown, of course.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Huh. Then all three of us chose the same
one...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Whoa!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Taishin, are you okay?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. I just tripped.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? You didn't skip breakfast
again,
did you? If you're not feeling
well—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I said I'm fine. And I had breakfast,
okay? I really
wish you'd stop already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I know—you saw me trip and got
worried. I get it,
but I just... I don't
wanna hear it anymore.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you're cut out for racing?
Maybe
you should reconsider. I don't
think you have the
constitution for it...
text_block_list.name: Woman

text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're seriously planning to go to
Tracen
Academy? You can't be for real. I
doubt they'd
let a runt like you enter
the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Elementary School Classmate A

text_block_list.text:
Keep dreaming, shorty. Not like
anything you try
will turn out good
anyway.
text_block_list.name: Elementary School Classmate B

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win. Even if I have to go up
against
both of you, I'm going to win the
Classic Triple
Crown.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, there's no point. I have to win
and
make my haters eat their words.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I understand, Taishin. I wouldn't expect
anything
less from you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But I don't intend to lose either. No
matter if I
race against you or Ticket, I
won't hold back.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Good. It'll be more satisfying when I
beat you,
then. See you at the Satsuki
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, this is our first
meeting this
year, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Happy New Year to you too.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Now, getting down to business... My
goals haven't
changed.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I still plan on becoming a racer whom no
one can
beat. I'm going to become the
greatest
Umamusume of all time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
I assume winning against Brian is also one of
your goals?

text_block_list.text:
That's right—which is why I want to
finalize my
winning equation as quickly
as possible.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What do you think is lacking from my
equation at
the moment?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Heh, you're right.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Then let's get started with our meeting.
That's
why we're here in the first place.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We can test things out in practice
afterwards.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ah, good point. Food is not only
essential for
maintaining health, it's also
important for
moderating stress.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should have a banana parfait
once in a
while...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I mean, I like other things
too. Like
banana cake...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, stop distracting me from our
real topic!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Technique? Interesting...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Let's start by gathering the data we
need.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We'll look at the Classic winners from
the past ten
years and see if we can
identify any trends.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: You're absolutely right. That's not enough, is it? Let's go through twenty years' worth of data.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I wish I'd kept my mouth shut, but still,
it's a
productive use of time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having finished our first meeting of the
year,
Biwa Hayahide and I treat
ourselves to a banana
parfait.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I share a spirited discussion with Biwa
Hayahide
about racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
